claim: Skipping saturated activity-word updates improves native coherent cached writes.
mechanism: Avoid an idempotent activity-word read-modify-write when all 64 bits are already active.
prediction: All paired mask/stock write time ratios below one on coherent64.
falsification: Mixed paired directions or consistently higher time.
change: Guard only the native cached-buffer activity-bit update with a whole-word saturation test.
result: write: stock 4.876005, mask 4.686548 ns/op; paired time ratio range 0.9424 to 1.0963.
maintainability: Experimental header overlay; generic library integration and additional platforms remain unvalidated.
codeComments: Patch comments state cache collision checks, invalidation and mask-word conditions.
decisionRationale: Classifies the bounded transfer experiment. Guardrail workload results determine upstream suitability; no production patch is installed.
risks: One Windows x64 compiler and processor.

claim: Separating secondary lookup from the common leaf-hit path makes the native cache improve coherent reads.
mechanism: E1 assembly showed a leaf-index lambda call in the cache variant's read loop. A small forced-inline entry point and non-inlined miss helper keep that call off last-leaf hits.
prediction: All paired split/stock read time ratios below one on coherent64; no unconditional leaf-lambda call on last-leaf hits in assembly.
falsification: Mixed paired directions, higher time, or an unconditional per-read helper call.
change: Preserve the original native membership predicate and tree fallback; move secondary lookup into an explicit miss helper.
result: read: stock 3.522404, split 2.367326 ns/op; paired time ratio range 0.5415 to 0.6749.
maintainability: Experimental header overlay; generic library integration and additional platforms remain unvalidated.
codeComments: Patch comments state cache collision checks, invalidation and mask-word conditions.
decisionRationale: Classifies the bounded transfer experiment. Guardrail workload results determine upstream suitability; no production patch is installed.
risks: One Windows x64 compiler and processor.

claim: The cache with a separate miss helper and saturated-mask guard improves native coherent writes.
mechanism: Combine the small common leaf-hit path with the cache and mask choices; native safety callbacks remain active.
prediction: All paired split_both/stock write time ratios below one on coherent64.
falsification: Mixed directions or higher time. Counterexample regressions require an optional policy rather than a universal recommendation.
change: Enable the explicit miss helper and mask guard in a combined native build.
result: write: stock 4.876005, split_both 3.516501 ns/op; paired time ratio range 0.7002 to 0.7901.
